buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PCDA NAVY MUMBAI

payable at PCDA NAVY MUMBAI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. EMD/MSME CERTIFICATE: EMD/MSME CERTIFICATES MUST BE UPLOADED AT THE TIME OF BIDDING. F ALLING TO UPLOAD THE SAME THE FIRM WILL BE DISQUALIFIED. 2. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS AND CONDITION: ACCEPTANCE LETTER FOR ALL TERMS AND CONDITION M UST BE UPLOADED ON FIRMS LETTER HEAD AT THE TIME OF BIDDING. FALLING TO UPLOAD THE SAME, TH E FIRM WILL BE DISQUALIFIED. 3. SELF DECLARATION CERTIFICATE: STATING THAT BIDDER/ FIRM HAS NEVER BEEN BANNED/ SUSPEN DED/BLACK LISTED BY ANY GOVT/PSU ORGANISATION. FALLING TO UPLOAD THE SAME, FIRM WILL BE DISQ UALIFIED. 4. BANK SOLVENCY CERTIFICATE: BANK SOLVENCY CERTIFICATE MUST BE UPLOADED AT THE TIME OF BIDDING. FALLING TO UPLOAD THE SAME, THE FIRM WILL BE DISQUALIFIED. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. BIDDER ARE ADVISED TO ADHERE TO MINIMUM WAGES ACT AS PER LATEST GOVERNMENT ORDERS AN D ANY SUBSEQUENT RISE IN RATE ALLOWANCE WILL NOT BE ENTERTAINED LATER. 2. THE SELLER/AWARDY'S BRANCH IS REQUIRED TO BE PLACED IN THE CONSIGNEE AREA, AFTER AWARD OF CONTRACT. .
